notes: Rod minigame coverage: Xorcist (static-meter supercharge policy), RecordBreaker (notch-vs-target rotation timing via right-click), Maelstrom (charge-aware release gate), and a rewritten Pinion's Aria that enumerates live notes instead of looking them up by name. Fixes the update channel: the manifest chain now asks jsDelivr first (the only source purged at publish time) instead of raw.githubusercontent, which sits behind a CDN cache that was serving the previous release for minutes after a publish and making the app report up to date against a manifest that no longer existed. Also mirrors the Lua bundle into build/bin/lua so packaging can no longer ship a stale copy.
